contract.description: Read and update the project registry: owner config that maps kebab-case aliases to absolute workspace paths (optional boardProjectId, displayName and description ride along) - the lookup behind project tags on memory writes. One strict-case action enum: List, Add, Update, Remove, Sync; a wrong or misspelled action is rejected with the allowed set spelled out. Add needs an alias plus at least one absolute path; Update replaces the whole path list and sets or clears the optional fields; Remove is explicit only; Sync pulls the project list from the local Overmind host, matches records by board id, adds new projects with a locally generated alias and marks projects that vanished from the board as gone - it never deletes. Rare door: the registry is owner config - confirm with the human before changing it. Registry edits resolve live: the remember and recall doors re-read the registry, no restart needed.
contract.name: projects
